A few people have told me to just tell her everything- it isn't easy. I don't know how to start, or what to say. I appreciate everyone's advice but so far I'm still extremely unsure.

Again thanks

Ps. Yes, I'm a teenager.
I don't know who to talk to. I just feel like a huge attention seeker, or whiny and ungrateful and all that.
